note: Control identifiers reference ISO/IEC 42001:2023 Annex A. Titles are paraphrased for operator readability; the authoritative wording is in the published standard. This file is the single source of truth for control mappings so additional frameworks (NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, AIUC-1) can be added without code changes.

A.5.5.title: AI system impact assessment
A.5.5.summary: Assess potential consequences of the AI system to individuals and groups.

A.6.2.4.title: AI system operation and monitoring
A.6.2.4.summary: Define and monitor the operation of the AI system once deployed.

A.6.2.8.title: Recording of event logs
A.6.2.8.summary: Record events arising during AI system operation to support traceability.

A.9.2.title: Processes for responsible use of AI systems
A.9.2.summary: Establish processes for the responsible use of the AI system.

A.9.4.title: Intended use of the AI system
A.9.4.summary: Operate the AI system in accordance with its intended use and constraints.

A.10.4.title: Suppliers and third-party services
A.10.4.summary: Govern interactions with external parties and third-party services.
